messages.subject: What is obj$he(parameter_value) returning?
parts:
Hello,

I thought obj$he returned the analytical hessian.

However, when I consider a  multivariate normal distritbution, where the Hessian matrix is available on the web,
obj$he and the analytical expression do not match. I have attached the code and also the analytical expression (jump to page 73--the page number is in the right lower corner).

Best regards 

Fredrik

messages.author: 02e03030784aa6a7
messages.subject: Re: What is obj$he(parameter_value) returning?
parts:
Hi, There is no problem with obj$he in TMB. I suspect that the difference is that the slides
do the differentiation with respect to sigma^2, while your TMB code is doing it wrt sigma.
